frames.notes: Wind lashes the catwalk. The lantern flickers. The tool bag swings. Noah works methodically on the antenna clamp. Aria steadies the lantern. A siren rises in the distance and cuts out.

overlay.blocking_indicator: Aria braces the lantern with her boot in the foreground. Noah stands at the rail, clamping the portable antenna to the rusted metal. The canvas tool bag swings in the wind between them. The town below is visible in the background—high school gym lit, gas station canopy lit, rest of town dark.
overlay.edit_intent: Establish the dangerous, isolated setting and the two-person teamwork. Introduce the environmental pressure (wind, darkness, siren). Dialogue exchange shows their dynamic—Noah's dry humor, Aria's focus. The siren punctuates the moment and raises stakes.
